title: Auth service 500 errors after deployment
summary: Spike in HTTP 500 errors from auth-service following v2.3.1 deployment. Root cause was a misconfigured JWT validation endpoint.
cause: JWT validation endpoint URL changed in config but not updated in deployment manifest.
resolution: Rolled back to v2.3.0, then deployed v2.3.2 with corrected config.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion
summary: Order service experienced timeout errors due to connection pool exhaustion on the primary SQL database.
cause: A new batch job was added without adjusting the connection pool max size, leading to starvation under load.
resolution: Increased pool size from 20 to 50 and added connection timeout alerts.

title: Memory leak in payment gateway
summary: Payment gateway pods OOMKilled repeatedly. Memory usage grew linearly over 4 hours.
cause: Unclosed HTTP client sessions in the retry logic path. Each failed retry created a new session without closing the previous one.
resolution: Fixed session lifecycle management, added memory usage metric alerts.
